label: Shelly Pro 4PM DIN-rail 4-channel smart switch
description: Shelly Pro 4PM is a DIN-rail four-channel smart switch (16 A per channel, 40 A total) with per-channel power metering, a 1.8-inch colour display, embedded web UI, MQTT and KNXnet/IP support. Unlike the Plus line it has a real RJ45 LAN port (100M Ethernet) alongside 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n WiFi and Bluetooth, so it can be wired straight into a switch or run wireless.
